articles.title: The U.S. government is betting $2 Billion on quantum computing, and the defense side can't keep up
articles.snippet: Pruden argues that to defend against a quantum computer capable of cryptographically relevant operations, we need post-quantum cryptography and regulatory coordination that the industry has been deferring for years.

articles.title: The company that makes your TV is taking ads onchain. Arbitrum helped
articles.snippet: LG Electronics has built a blockchain-based advertising platform with the help of Arbitrum.

articles.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX prices shares at $135, raising $75 billion in largest-ever IPO
articles.snippet: The company's fully diluted value will be about $1.8 trillion, with the stock set to open for trade on Friday on the Nasdaq.

articles.title: Exodus launches tokenized stock marketplace with Ondo, adds 200-plus onchain equities
articles.snippet: The launch comes as tokenized equities surge in popularity, with crypto exchanges and wallets racing to offer onchain access to stocks and pre-IPO companies.

articles.title: LG, Arbitrum launch blockchain-based bid in $679B ad market
articles.snippet: LG is building a blockchain focused on buying and selling ads, joining a wave of companies launching their own blockchains in recent years.
